_note: Audit registry for example content in the hosted Clay preview. Every top-level literal data block in the hosted page must be listed here (tests/clay/hosted-examples.test.mjs fails on an unlisted one), so new example content cannot slip in unreviewed.

classes.ui-config: Option lists, icons, palettes, rules. No example records.
classes.generic-editorial: General advice or education naming no brand, product or person.
classes.reference-real: Real-world reference content naming real products, brands, perfumes or places. Not synthetic, not user data. Needs a reviewer decision.
classes.illustrative-invented: Invented product-like or user-like records, figures or claims. Each must show a visible label in the hosted page.
classes.unreferenced: Sample block never used by any rendering code; emptied in the hosted build.
